English.Char_Desc_2000:
Proofreader corrects spelling, grammar, punctuation, spacing and capital letters in Word (.doc, .docx), Rich Text (.rtf) and text (.txt) documents, one or hundreds at a time. Add files or whole folders, tick what to fix and click Start proofreading. Corrected copies go into a "corrected" folder beside the originals, which are never changed, and a report lists every change. Anything doubtful is not changed but listed under "Left for you to decide" with the likely choices. Names, words in capitals and swear words are left alone. Pause, Stop and pick up where you left off. The free checker, LanguageTool with its own Java, comes inside and runs on your computer only, so nothing you write goes online. When Microsoft Word is installed, its checker gives a second opinion. English (United States).
Before you install: Microsoft Word is optional: without it, .docx and .txt documents are corrected by the free checker that comes with the Proofreader, and only .doc and .rtf documents need Word. Setup tells you if Word is not found. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. The installer is not code-signed (a signing certificate is a paid yearly service), so Windows may show a blue "Windows protected your PC" box: click More info, then Run anyway. A few antivirus programs wrongly flag new unsigned programs; you can check the download against the SHA-256 fingerprint on its release page. No administrator password is needed.

Permissions.Distribution_Permissions: Proofreader is free to use and share. Download sites may list it and offer the unchanged Setup.exe, or link to the download page.
Permissions.EULA: Proofreader is free and comes with no warranty. Use it at your own risk. The free parts it is built from keep their own licenses, listed in the licenses folder it installs.
